issues.explanation: Chapter 34 ends by saying Zhao Yun rushed to the west gate to pursue and kill Cai Mao, but Chapter 35 shows Zhao Yun merely catching up, questioning Cai Mao, searching for Liu Bei, and then withdrawing. This makes the immediate handoff misleading and conflicts with the source continuation.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the ending to say Zhao Yun rushed to the west gate after Cai Mao, with his purpose and Liu Bei's fate still unknown; omit “追杀” or recast it as simply “追赶”。
